text:
maya: Quick copy check — small tooltip for Model precision dropdown + one-line empty-state for when KV cache is unavailable in private deploys. Screenshot: https://redwood.example/screenshot.png. Posting 3 initial variants, please react with the number you prefer and any tiny wording nits.

maya: Variants:```1) "Model precision: lower precision reduces cost and latency; output may be slightly different." (aria: "Model precision may affect fidelity and cost.")
2) "Model precision: lower precision can be faster and cheaper; outputs may lose detail." (aria: "Lower precision may alter output detail.")
3) "Model precision — choose speed or fidelity. Lower precision = faster, cheaper, possibly less detail." (aria: "Choose precision with tradeoffs between speed and output fidelity.")```

darren: quick read — 2 feels clearest. but "lose detail" sounds a bit casual. maybe "reduce detail"? :thinking: 

evan: I prefer 2 too. Suggest swap to "outputs may have reduced detail" for tone + a11y. Also watch tooltip width; it's tight.

showk: a11y nit — avoid starting tooltip with a verb phrase. Leading with "Lower precision can be faster and cheaper; outputs may have reduced detail." is fine. add an info icon with `aria-describedby` pointing at the tooltip id so SRs announce it.

design-bot: a11y-scan: tooltip text length 92 chars; contrast passes. recommend linking to docs for full tradeoffs.

danny: eng constraint — tooltip max width 220px (~60-70 chars visible). need one-line compact version for UI: "Lower precision = faster, cheaper. May reduce output detail."

maya: ok here's proposed final tooltip (compact) + empty-state for KV cache disabled:```Tooltip (compact): "Lower precision = faster, cheaper. May reduce output detail."Empty state (KV cache disabled): "KV cache disabled for this deployment. Responses may be slower; caching reduces latency and cost. Learn more → https://redwood.example/kv-cache"```

evan: LGTM. use "KV cache" capitalization for consistency. reorder the empty-state sentence to emphasize latency first (done here).

darren: +1. tiny nit: remove period after arrow in the Learn more link so it doesn't read like a sentence.

maya: updated copy pushed above. placement: tooltip on hover of the precision label; empty state inline under Model settings when cache unavailable.

danny: implem note: will add `role="tooltip"`, ensure keyboard focusable. can match tooltip width constraint.

evan: :thumbsup: 

darren: approving copy. can we also add a one-line blurb to release notes UI? just a short heads-up.

maya: will add a one-line entry in the release notes and in the console changelog. thanks all!
